facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Pollyanna had an accident. A car hit her. She could not move her legs. She was badly hurt.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: One terrible day, Pollyanna was crossing the road. A car came too fast and hit her very hard. The townspeople rushed over, crying and calling her name. She was badly hurt and could not move her legs at all. The doctor examined her and looked very worried. Everyone in town was heartbroken about their sunny girl.
facts.Word cards: hurt = 다쳤다 / badly = 심하게 / accident = 사고 / recovery = 회복
